title: POLY-GRENAILLE - edition numerique des oeuvres morales de Francois de Grenaille
notes: POLY-GRENAILLE (Grenolle ELAN platform, live 200) is a digital critical edition of the 1640s moral works of Francois de Grenaille including his La Mode (Paris 1642), matching the harvest origin 'ELAN polygrenaille: grenaille_la_mode' (39 texts). Published within UMR Litt&Arts' ELAN platform with TEI encoding and critical annotation (never previously modern-edited). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: ELAN / UMR Litt&Arts (CNRS / Universite Grenoble Alpes), dir. Cecile Lignereux and Bernard Roukhomovsky (project MoREM)
